name: score_directory_with_jev
description: Discover and score files in an authorized directory, optionally recursively by basename glob and with bounded source excerpts

file_glob.description: Optional basename pattern such as *.js; matches files only

include_content.description: Send up to 1024 bytes from each matched file to Jev; requires automatic file_read permission

recursive.description: Search subdirectories when file_glob is set

search_criteria.description: What the sought file or directory should contain or do
